# 1 Enoch Chapter 14 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers, in accordance with the command of the Holy and Great One, delivered in that vision.

**2** I saw in my sleep what I will now speak with a tongue of flesh and with the breath of my mouth, which the Great One has given to men for speech and understanding of the heart.

**3** As He created and appointed to mankind the power to understand the word of wisdom, so He created me and appointed me to reprimand the Watchers, the sons of heaven.

**4** I wrote out your petition, but in my vision it was shown thus: that your petition will not be granted to you for all the days of eternity, and that final judgment has been passed upon you — your petition will not be granted.

**5** From this time forward you shall not ascend into heaven for all eternity. In the bonds of the earth the decree has gone forth to bind you for all the generations of the world.

**6** Before that, you shall have seen the destruction of your beloved sons, and you shall have no pleasure in them — they shall fall before you by the sword.

**7** Your petition on their behalf shall not be granted, nor on your own behalf — though you weep and pray and speak all the words contained in the writing which I have written.

**8** And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds called to me and a mist summoned me, and the paths of the stars and flashes of lightning hastened me and drove me, and winds in the vision caused me to fly and bore me upward into heaven.

**9** I entered until I drew near to a wall built of crystal and surrounded by tongues of fire, and it began to fill me with fear.

**10** I passed through the tongues of fire and drew near to a great house built of crystal. The walls of the house were like a tessellated floor of crystal, and its foundation was of crystal.

**11** Its ceiling was like the path of the stars and flashes of lightning, and among them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was clear as water.

**12** A flaming fire surrounded the walls, and its gates blazed with fire.

**13** I entered that house, and it was as hot as fire and as cold as ice. There were no comforts of life in it. Fear overwhelmed me, and trembling seized me.

**14** And as I trembled and shook, I fell upon my face.

**15** And I saw a vision — behold, there was another house, greater than the first, and its entire entrance stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.

**16** In every respect it so excelled in glory and magnificence and size that I cannot describe to you its splendor and its extent.

**17** Its floor was of fire, and above were lightning and the paths of the stars, and its ceiling also was of flaming fire.

**18** I looked and saw within it a lofty throne. Its appearance was like crystal, and its wheels were like the shining sun, and there was the appearance of cherubim.

**19** From beneath the throne came streams of flaming fire, so that I could not look upon it.

**20** And the Great Glory sat upon it, and His garment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.

**21** None of the angels could enter or behold His face because of the magnificence and glory, and no flesh could look upon Him.

**22** Flaming fire encircled Him, and a great fire stood before Him, and none who surrounded Him could draw near. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before Him, yet He needed no counselor.

**23** And the most holy ones who were near to Him did not depart by night or leave His presence.

**24** Until that moment I had been prostrate on my face, trembling. And the Lord called me with His own mouth and said to me: 'Come here, Enoch, and hear My word.'

**25** And one of the holy ones came to me and roused me, and made me rise and approach the door. And I bowed my face downward.


---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text, preserving sentence structure and key theological vocabulary while producing readable English prose. Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the Ge'ez.*
